name: protocols.io
description: Find public protocols on protocols.io, read their steps and reagents, and import one as a draft protocol of your own.
author: Sheetbase

operations.title: Search protocols.io
operations.description: Searches public protocols on protocols.io, such as a PicoGreen assay or a Gibson assembly. Only the words searched leave the workspace, so never include sample names or unpublished results. Each protocol has a title, authors, a link and a DOI. Read one with `read`; to keep one, use `import`.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: What to look for, such as picogreen dna quantification.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: At most this many, up to 20. Default 8.

operations.title: Read a protocols.io protocol
operations.description: Reads one public protocol from protocols.io: its description, numbered steps and reagents. Name it by the `id`, `uri` or DOI that `search` returned. Summarise or compare from these steps only, never from memory.

inputs.name: protocol
inputs.description: The protocol's id, uri or DOI.

operations.title: Import a protocols.io protocol
operations.description: Imports one public protocol from protocols.io as a draft protocol of the lab's own, with its steps, reagents and a link back to the source. The person confirms first. Name it by the `id`, `uri` or DOI that `search` returned.

inputs.name: protocol
inputs.description: The protocol's id, uri or DOI.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: A different title; the source's own if left out.
